basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant (Pediatrics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Rishikesh has invited applications for one Research Assistant post under the extramural funded research project “Evaluation of the efficacy and safety of Suprabrain® in children with autism spectrum disorder”, purely on a temporary basis, at a consolidated fixed salary of Rs 25,000 per month. The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in any subject related to medical science (like psychology or psychiatry) or life science from a recognized university or equivalent, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Applications are received from 5 November 2026 to 15 November 2026 (5:00 PM) b

important_dates.interview_date: Will be communicated on the AIIMS, Rishikesh website

how_to_apply: Prepare the filled application form together with all necessary documents supporting the qualification and other information.
Combine the form and the documents into a single merged PDF.
Send it so that it is received by 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Incomplete applications and applications received after the last date and time will not be considered.
The notice does not print a subject line for the email or a format for the application form.
important_instructions: At the time of document verification/interview, candidates must bring a duly completed hard copy of the application form, all original certificates/documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test, document verification or interview. The selected candidate must join within five days of issue of the offer letter, failing which the offer may be cancelled and offered to the next eligible candidate. The selected candidate may be required to work at AIIMS Rishikesh or at any project-related site, as per project requirements. The post gives no right to regular appointment or absorption in AIIMS Rishikesh. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure. The appointee may resign by giving one month's notice or salary in lieu thereof, subject to acceptance by the Competent Authority and completion of handover formalities. The appointment may be terminated by the Competent Authority, on the recommendation of the Principal Investigator, if performance or conduct is found unsatisfactory, as per applicable rules. AIIMS Rishikesh reserves the right not to fill the post, to cancel the recruitment process, or to modify the number of posts, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rishikesh Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in an extramural funded research project at AIIMS Rishikesh that evaluates the efficacy and safety of Suprabrain® in children with autism spectrum disorder. The notice is issued by the Principal Investigator, AIIMS Rishikesh, and the interview venue is the Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Rishikesh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Research Assistant (Vacancy-1). Age: the notice gives the maximum age limit as 35 years, counted as on the last date of application. Age relaxation, wherever applicable, is admissible in accordance with prevailing Central Government/ICMR and AIIMS Rishikesh rules. The notice does not list the relaxation by category. Experience is counted only after the minimum essential qualification prescribed for the post has been obtained. Candidates must make sure they meet the qualification, experience and age requirements. False or incorrect information found at any stage leads to cancellation of candidature or appointment and may invite appropriate action. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: A Master's Degree in any subject related to medical science (like psychology or psychiatry) or life science from a recognized university or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated fixed salary is Rs 25,000/- per month. No allowances or facilities other than the approved consolidated emoluments and admissible HRA, if any, are payable. The post is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for three months. It may be extended, based on satisfactory performance, project requirements and availability of funds, up to one year or until completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Any extension is subject to a satisfactory performance evaluation by the Principal Investigator and approval of the Competent Authority. Leave is admissible as per the rules applicable to project staff/contractual employees of AIIMS Rishikesh.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare the filled application form together with all necessary documents supporting the qualification and other information. Combine the form and the documents into a single merged PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] . Send it so that it is received by 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Incomplete applications and applications received after the last date and time will not be considered. Applications are received from 5 November 2026. The notice does not print a subject line for the email or a format for the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted on the basis of the information in the application form, qualifications and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates may be called for the selection process. The method of selection may include a written test, an interview, or both, as decided by the Selection Committee. If required, a written test may be held before the interview. The Selection Committee is constituted with the approval of the Competent Authority, AIIMS Rishikesh, and its decision is final. The interview is held at the Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Rishikesh, and the date will be communicated on the AIIMS, Rishikesh website. The interview is conducted only after physical verification of original documents. Requests for an online interview are not entertained. Permission to appear in the selection process does not mean a candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria. Eligibility is finally determined after verification of original documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Assistant vacancies are there at AIIMS Rishikesh?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Assistant, shown as Vacancy-1 in the notice, under the extramural project on Suprabrain® in children with autism spectrum disorder.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date of receiving applications is 15 Nov 2026 (5:00 PM). Applications are received from 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in any subject related to medical science (like psychology or psychiatry) or life science from a recognized university or equivalent is the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation is admissible as per prevailing Central Government/ICMR and AIIMS Rishikesh rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated fixed salary is Rs 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form with all documents supporting the qualification and other information, as a single merged PDF, to [email protected] by 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates may be shortlisted from the application form, qualifications and experience. Selection may include a written test, an interview, or both, as decided by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project, and gives no right to regular appointment or absorption. The initial term is three months, extendable up to one year or until project completion, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will HRA or other allowances be paid on top of the Rs 25,000 salary?
faq.answer: No allowances or facilities other than the approved consolidated emoluments and admissible HRA, if any, are payable.

faq.question: Q10. Can I attend the AIIMS Rishikesh interview online, and is TA/DA paid?
faq.answer: Requests for an online interview are not entertained, because the interview follows physical verification of original documents. No TA/DA is paid for the written test, document verification or interview.
